beats.text: Food makes up 95.3% of exports from Belize. In China, it is just 2.3%.
This share counts food, live animals, beverages, tobacco, and oils among all goods sold abroad.
Other nations rely heavily on farming: Malawi has 93.3%, The Gambia has 90.7%, and Ethiopia has 80.4%.
Major exporters vary. New Zealand has 68.8% while Brazil has 40.7%.
Libya has 0.1%, the world's lowest. Belize has 953 times the share Libya has.
Global giants are lower. India has 11.9% and the USA has 9.0%.
